summary: Weekly bug hunt: build, lint and all 108 smoke tests pass, live site up. Fixed one accessibility bug on the Study page (a thumbnail link with no name) and added a test for it.
why: Sunday is the weekly bug hunt. The Study page is new and hadn't been reviewed; its thumbnail link was unnamed for keyboard and screen-reader users.

findings.title: Study thumbnail link had no name
findings.detail: A second link to the same video with only an empty-alt image inside; now hidden from the tab order and screen readers.

changes.title: Study: thumbnail link out of tab order, smoke test for nameless links
